result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: a loading spinner remains stuck over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image.

issues.description: A white circular loading spinner is stuck visible in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring the food photo even though the image underneath appears loaded.
issues.suggestion: Fix image loading state so the spinner is dismissed once the image finishes loading; do not show loader overlay on top of loaded content
